text: The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය
අති විෙශෂ
No. 2397/11 – MONDAY, AUGUST 12, 2024
EXTRAORDINARY

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) ,, Notice under Section 7 My Ref. No.: BD/HD/LND/3/1/ඒ. එම්. ජයතිස්ස. Tourism & Land's Ministry’s Ref. No.: 4-3/7/2017/HW/198. I hereby give notice under Sub - section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following lands/ servitude which is required for a Public Purpose.
Description of the land/ servitude to be acquired:

An allotment of Land in total extent of about 0.0996 hectare depicted as Lot No. 01 in the Cadastral Map No. 710574 Block No. 02, Sheet No.01 dated 08.04.2024 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Village called Marangahawela in the Grama Niladhari Division No. 158F of Marangahawela in Kandapalla Korale Minor Division in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of
Haldummulla in Badulla District of Uva Province and described by as follows:

01. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Gadolwalahena; Description of Land: Estate, A mixed crop cultivation of about 15-20 years old and a well are available; Claimant: Late Aththanayaka Mohottalalage Jayathissa of Marangahawela, Uwathenna and now his Wife, Mrs. Kodithuwakku Arachchilage Mebal of Marangahawela, Uwathenna; Extent: 0.0996 Hectare. ( 39.4 Perches) Boundary Details: North by: Lot No. 37 of F.V.P. 286.; East by: Lot Lot No. 37 and Lot No 289 of F.V.P. 286; South by: Lot No. 289 and Lot Nos. 37 of F.V.P. 286; West by: Lot Nos. 37 of F.V.P 286.
Objective :- To construct the structures related to landslide control at the landslide site prone area between culverts 168/10 - 168/11 on the Colombo to Batticaloa Road.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
(Published by Authority) PART III — LANDS Land Acquisition Notices
2 A III ෙකොටස - ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් අති විෙශෂ ගැසට් පතය - 2024.08.12 Pൺඋඍ III – GAZETTE EXTRAORDINARY OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA – 12.08.2024
PRINTED AT THE DEPARTMENT OF GOVERNMENT PRINTING, SRI LANKA.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/ servitude are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing before me at Haldummulla Divisional Secretariat on the 23rd October, 2024 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 16th October, 2024 the nature of their interest in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the
said lands/ servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
K.A.J. Priyangika, Divisional Secretary, Haldummulla.
At Divisional Secretariat, Haldummulla. 05th August 2024.
